description: Official field boundaries for the Wallonia region of Belgium, comprising 341,968 agricultural parcels from the Parcellaire Agricole Anonyme (PAA) dataset. Represents anonymous agricultural plots managed under the EU Common Agricultural Policy by the Wallonia Paying Agency, including crop name and code attributes. Sourced from the INSPIRE Geoportal and converted to fiboa GeoParquet format in EPSG:3035 projection.

## README.md
# Field boundaries for Belgium, Wallonia

Provides 341968 official field boundaries from Belgium, Wallonia.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from INSPIRE Geoportal by the European Commission.

- **Source Data Provider:** [INSPIRE Geoportal by the European Commission](https://inspire-geoportal.ec.europa.eu/)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** No conditions apply to access and use. Distributed through Inspire guidelines
- **Projection:** EPSG:3035

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/be-wa/be_wa.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/be-wa/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/be-wa/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/be-wa/be_wa.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property               | **Data Type** | Description |
|------------------------|---------------|-------------|
| crop_name              | string        |             |
| crop_code              | string        |             |
| id                     | string        |             |
| determination_datetime | timestamp     |             |

- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.7.0
